findings.evidence: Lines 94 and 111 define both constructions from an ambient subrepresentation, while Mathlib line 178 defines `isotypicComponent R M S` for an arbitrary module `S`; the roadmap lines 359–363 indexes blocks by irreducibles `π`, including types not occurring in a given ambient representation.
findings.fix: Parameterize the kernel by an independent finite-dimensional continuous representation `sigma : ContRepresentation k G W`; parameterize the projector by both `rho` and `sigma`, and state its range as `isotypicComponent k[G] rho.toRepresentation.asModule sigma.toRepresentation.asModule`. Derive any subrepresentation-specialized statements afterward if needed.
findings.issue: `isotypicKernel`, `isotypicProjector`, and all characteristic theorems through line 419 take `sigma : Subrepresentation rho.toRepresentation`, so one cannot construct or prove vanishing of the projector for an irreducible representation absent from `rho`, nor index projectors by an external irreducible skeleton.

summary: The projector API is unnecessarily restricted to irreducible types already realized as subrepresentations of the ambient representation.
